purpose: Defines the default JSON plan format, field definitions and status values, and the feature_marker.py contract for judging parallel (temporary-feature) state of documents.
summary: Rationale for choosing JSON for plans so start-implement can parse and update them mechanically
Plans carry no frontmatter; additive feature status is derived from the linked requirements document
JSON schema with requirements_traceability, design_traceability and tasks top-level keys
Field definitions for each section, including task status, build_check and required_reading
Status values and pointers to the documents that define transitions
feature_marker.py frontmatter parsing using only the standard library
Three-way judgment: in parallel state, not in parallel state, parse failure
Parse failure cases and the rule that key order must not change the result
Callers must stop and report path and reason when judgment is impossible
tasks: Creating or validating an implementation plan JSON
Judging whether a document is a temporary-feature
Reviewing plan documents against the format
